title: Calibrate a 4–20 mA input
summary: Perform the version 3.0 two-point calibration workflow and verify engineering-unit scaling.

sections.title: Two-point calibration
paragraphs: Version 3.0 stores zero and span values but does not capture the reference-device metadata introduced in version 3.2.
steps: Place the loop in a reviewed maintenance state.
Apply 4.000 mA and accept the zero reference.
Apply 20.000 mA and accept the span reference.
Restore the loop and document the external test equipment manually.
